description.value: R Ki Coffee Lab is a specialty coffee roastery and café in Richmond, BC that sources beans directly from origin farmers and international auctions, performing rigorous batch-level quality control including Agtron colour, moisture, and blind cupping on its 3.2kg semi-air drum roaster. The lab has earned international recognition, placing in worldwide mystery-coffee leaderboards and participating in events such as the 2026 Shanghai Hotelex and Panama Highlands Treasures. They also operate an adjacent dessert studio and host ticketed coffee-cupping and sensory sessions.
